title: Tesla, Uber, and Waymo all get the OK to operate thousands of robotaxis in Nevada | TechCrunch
summary: The Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved three permits Thursday that will allow Tesla, Uber, and Waymo to operate commercial robotaxi services in Clark County, home to Las Vegas. Home batteries are suddenly cheap and everywhere.
